name: Effigy Row
description: A section of Lorehold College lined with statues of heroes, where mentor spirits are summoned.

timeline.summary: Quint grows tired of his spirit mentor Asterion, who talks only of scones and trivia.
timeline.quote: Five minutes into his first encounter with Asterion, Quintorius decided that he had heard just about enough from his spirit mentor.

timeline.summary: Quint performs the Rousing, a burst of heatless flame that animates Asterion's statue.
timeline.quote: a bright burst of heatless flame engulfed the statue

timeline.summary: Quint reads Asterion his genealogy from the school's records.
timeline.quote: Your father was Lord Teutamos of Pallad Reach

timeline.summary: Quint asks about Asterion's death, noting reports he left toward Pillardrop and was never found.
timeline.quote: A series of reports indicate that you were last seen leaving the school grounds traveling toward Pillardrop.

timeline.summary: Asterion says his memories of the end are fragments.
timeline.quote: Would you believe me if I told you that I can't quite recall?

timeline.summary: Asterion asks to see the cave, but Quint says spirit statues cannot leave Effigy Row.
timeline.quote: Spirit statues aren't permitted to leave Effigy Row.

timeline.summary: Quint reveals he helps at the dig where Asterion's statue was found, hoping to prove the school sits on Moragitzu-Kesh.
timeline.quote: it's the cave where they found your statue buried under an ancient rockslide

timeline.summary: Asterion recites the Canticle of Jed and says the lost city is Zantafar, which he sought long ago.
timeline.quote: I know enough not to mistake Zantafar for Moragitzu-Kesh.

timeline.summary: Asterion urges Quint to find the lost city of Zantafar as his responsibility.
timeline.quote: There's a lost city to discover.

pages_say.description: A section of Lorehold College lined with statues of heroes, where mentor spirits are summoned.
